name: Preethi Asrani
bio: Preethi Asrani is a south Indian actress and model who works mainly in Tamil, Telugu films and TV Serial industry.

credits.title: Balti
credits.overview: A star kabaddi player's life takes a dangerous turn when he's pulled into the criminal underworld.

credits.title: Kiss
credits.overview: A musician is gifted with the supernatural ability to see a couple's destiny whenever they kiss. But when he sees the grim fate of the woman he loves, he must use his powers to defy destiny itself.

credits.title: Election

In the world outside Eva, a Hollywood starlet dies under mysterious circumstances, so do a tycoon and a super model. An unknown drug seem to hold the key to the whole mystery.

credits.overview: All a full-time bank employee and part-time kabaddi coach wants is to bring national relevance to the school his father built and help young kabaddi players in his village win the national championship. It might prove difficult than just coaching them though.

credits.title: A (Ad Infinitum)
credits.overview: Sanjeev cannot recollect his past but keeps dreaming of it. But what he ends up finding out is much more than what he bargained for.

credits.title: Pressure Cooker
credits.overview: A young man faces immense pressure from his family to move to America, get a job and have his life settled abroad.

credits.title: Malli Raava
credits.overview: Karthik and Anjali are childhood sweethearts who fell in love when they're fourteen. Despite having immense love for each other, circumstances forced them apart many a time. Will things change when they grow older? Will their love story finally have a happy ending?
